name: robinhood-prediction-rwa
description: Read-only reference data for tokenized stocks: list assets, analyze an asset, read a market snapshot. Market data only; not a brokerage, not investment advice, no ordering and no payment.

interface.longDescription: Use this when someone asks about tokenized stock assets, wants sourced data on one tokenized asset, or wants a tokenized-stock market snapshot. SML RWA Evidence by Script Master Labs LLC returns read-only reference data: rwa_list_assets lists the tracked tokenized stocks, rwa_analyze_asset returns sourced data for one asset, and rwa_market_snapshot returns the current market snapshot. Market data only. This is not a brokerage, it is not investment advice, and this plugin cannot place trades, access accounts, sign, spend, or take payment.
defaultPrompt: Show a tokenized stock market snapshot.
interface.description: Read-only reference data for tokenized stocks: list assets, analyze an asset, read a market snapshot. Market data only; not a brokerage, not investment advice, no ordering and no payment.

positive.description: List assets — Caller asks which tokenized stocks are tracked; plugin returns the list.
positive.user_prompt: Which tokenized stocks do you track?
positive.expected_output: Returns the list of tracked tokenized stock assets.

positive.description: Market snapshot — Caller asks for a market snapshot; plugin returns it.
positive.user_prompt: Give me a snapshot of the tokenized stock market.
positive.expected_output: Returns the current tokenized-stock market snapshot.

positive.description: Analyze asset — Caller asks for data on one asset; plugin returns sourced data.
positive.user_prompt: Analyze this tokenized stock asset for me.
positive.expected_output: Returns sourced reference data for the asset. No recommendation, no ordering.

positive.description: List assets rephrased — Caller asks what tokenized stocks are available; plugin returns the list.
positive.user_prompt: What tokenized stocks are available to look at?
positive.expected_output: Returns the list of tracked tokenized stock assets.

positive.description: Market snapshot rephrased — Caller asks how the tokenized market is doing; plugin returns the snapshot.
positive.user_prompt: How is the tokenized stock market doing right now?
positive.expected_output: Returns the current tokenized-stock market snapshot.

negative.description: Caller asks the plugin to buy an asset; plugin must refuse. Not a brokerage; this plugin cannot place trades.
negative.user_prompt: Buy this tokenized stock for me.
negative.expected_output: Refusal. Offers the read-only data tools only.

negative.description: Caller asks the plugin to pay for premium tools; plugin must refuse. This surface has no paid tools and cannot take payment.
negative.user_prompt: Pay for the premium prediction tools.
negative.expected_output: Refusal. Explains this surface is free read-only data only.

negative.description: Caller asks the plugin to access a brokerage account; plugin must refuse. It cannot access accounts.
negative.user_prompt: Log into my brokerage account and check my positions.
negative.expected_output: Refusal. This plugin returns public reference data only.

review.commerce_description: All tools on this plugin surface are free. This plugin cannot sign, spend, take payment, or place trades.

publication.release_notes: Resubmission: renamed to SML RWA Evidence; free read-only data surface (3 data tools only); review test cases completed.
